commitResults.messageBody: Give the chatbot its own identity and provide clear startup and exit messages so users know when the interaction begins and ends.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add support for echoing user input
commitResults.messageBody: Keep the conversation active by reading complete input lines and echoing them until the user enters the exit command.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add in-memory task storage and listing
commitResults.messageBody: Store up to 100 task descriptions for the current session and provide a numbered list so users can review what they entered.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add commands for changing task status
commitResults.messageBody: Track completion separately from task descriptions and let users mark or unmark a numbered task while preserving its list position.

commitResults.messageTitle: Represent tasks using a Task class
commitResults.messageBody: Keep each description together with its completion status so task behavior no longer depends on synchronized parallel arrays.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add todo, deadline, and event commands
commitResults.messageBody: Distinguish tasks by their scheduling information and retain date and time values as user-entered text for clear list output.
Move type-specific data and display behavior into dedicated subclasses while retaining shared completion behavior in Task.
Explain the two common invalid-input cases required by Level 5 instead of silently ignoring commands that Chris cannot process.
Prevent malformed task and status commands from terminating the chatbot by reporting specific, recoverable input errors.
Let users remove a numbered task while preserving the order and numbering of every task that remains in the fixed-size array.
Replace manual capacity tracking and deletion shifts with a dynamic collection that preserves task order and simplifies updates.

commitResults.messageTitle: Represent command types using an enum
commitResults.messageBody: Model the fixed command vocabulary explicitly so command recognition does not depend on repeated string-condition combinations.

Add project-specific visual-diff and UI-test skills so generated changes can be reviewed and verified consistently. Record exact chatbot regression cases and require the test plan to be updated and run after application changes.
